meta.title: 2 Weeks in Vietnam | Full Travel Itinerary & Cost Breakdown
meta.description:
On this two week trip in Vietnam, we will visit Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), Mui Ne, Mekong Delta, Da Lat, and Nha Trang.  Join as on this adventure as we explore the busting city, mysterious jungles, enormous sand dunes, and stunning beaches, in this geographically diverse country.  Stay to the end for a full cost breakdown and find out how much we spent on this trip.  

Filmed In:  January 2024

**Please remember to turn on subtitles / CC for different languages!

If you enjoy our travel vlogs, please do hit that Like & Subscribe button or share it with your friends.  We really appreciate all the support!

#vietnam #saigon #dalat #muine #nhatrang

PRESENTED and SHOT BY:
Jeffrey:  https://www.instagram.com/jhmedium
Rika:  https://www.instagram.com/rikasplanet

Business Inquiries:  jhmediumproductions@gmail.com

VIDEO CHAPTERS:
00:00 - Preview
00:40 - Ho Chi Minh City, Saigon
10:10 - Mui Ne
14:05 - HCMC, Saigon (Part 2)
17:52 - Mekong Delta
24:02 - HCMC, Saigon (Part 3)
27:20 - Saigon to Da Lat Sleeper Bus
29:06 - Da Lat
51:02 - Nha Trang
01:01:15 - Cost Breakdown


GEAR:
Main Cameras:  Fujifilm X-H2s, Fujifilm X-T4
Lenses:  Fujifilm 18-120mm f4, Fujifilm 35mm f2, Tamron 11-28mm f2.8
Drone:  DJI Mavic Air 2
360 Cam:  Insta360 X3
Phone:  iPhone 14 Pro
Sound:  DJI Mic & Deity D3 Pro
